status: correction and withdrawal audit; does not re-adopt interventions
finding: Two of ten historical crops have valid byte/pixel provenance but depict the wrong units. Source extraction and hashes were correct; visual target identification failed. Other eight have been re-identified locally but still need independent review before re-adoption.
root_cause: The first two locations were inferred from page overviews rather than traced from known page opening through the complete target wording.
Recorded expected Tibetan context came from the supplied transcript; this was incorrectly treated as if it authenticated the pictured target.
Exact hashes and crop coordinates verified image provenance but could not verify that the image depicted the claimed anchor.
Confidence in terminal strokes was reported before resolving target identity; those confidence claims must not be retained as validated review.
